type T = { new (): object; x?: number };
class C {}
const v: T = C;
interface Maker {
  new (label: string): { label: string };
  tag?: string;
}
class Labeled {
  constructor(public label: string) {}
}
const m: Maker = Labeled;
type Both = { new (): object } & { x?: number };
const both: Both = C;
type Weak = { x?: number };
console.log(typeof v, new m('a').label, typeof both);
